mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior 6-month average signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.3% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior 6-month average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth < -0.2% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).
